testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hides a ribbon panel from its title context menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:954:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hides a ribbon panel from its title context menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the Sketch ribbon's Layout panel is hidden ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Create panel title context menu ✔ Then Layout is listed as unchecked in the panel visibility submenu ✔ When the user selects Layout ✔ Then the Layout panel appears on the Sketch ribbon ✔ And Make Part and Make Components are unavailable ✔ And Create Block is available ✔ When the user opens Show Panels from the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user selects Layout again ✔ Then the Layout panel is hidden from the Sketch ribbon ✔ And the sketch remains active and unchanged
